python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=True)

python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=True)
ws = wb.active
vals = [(ws.cell(r,1).value, ws.cell(r,2).value, ws.cell(r,3).value) for r in range(11,23)]
total = sum(v[2] for v in vals)

from collections import defaultdict
d = defaultdict(float)
